name: Windows PMTU Black Hole Detection Disabled
description:
Ensures EnablePMTUBHDetect is disabled (0) to prevent inconsistent path MTU discovery behavior that can degrade network reliability.
Required Windows permission (remedy only): the LEA agent account must be allowed to run reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect (administrator rights) via a delegated run-as permission, Scheduled Task, or service configuration.

_remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnablePMTUBHDetect
